<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

Two files are changed: `Makefile` gains `image-pushing`, `image-pushing-release-artifacts`, and `image-pushing-helper-artifacts` targets with `JOB_TYPE`-conditional parallelism dispatch and aggregated push dependencies; `cloudbuild.yaml` replaces eight explicit push targets with a single `image-pushing` invocation.

## Changes

**Image-pushing orchestration**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Makefile targets and Cloud Build invocation** <br> `Makefile`, `cloudbuild.yaml` | Adds `.PHONY: image-pushing` umbrella, `image-pushing-release-artifacts` with a `JOB_TYPE`-conditional recipe that re-invokes `make` with `-j3` for `periodic` or `-j5` otherwise, and `image-pushing-helper-artifacts` depending on `debug-image-push`, `importer-image-push`, and `ray-project-mini-image-build-push`. Updates `cloudbuild.yaml` to call `image-pushing` in place of the previous list of eight individual push targets. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#12113](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/12113): Introduces `ray-project-mini-image-build-push`, which is a prerequisite of the new `image-pushing-helper-artifacts` target.

- **Makefile:256** by [@coderabbitai[bot]](https://github.com/apps/coderabbitai) — 2026-06-17T07:56:01Z
```diff
@@ -244,6 +244,20 @@ image-build:
 		$(IMAGE_BUILD_EXTRA_OPTS) \
 		./
 
+.PHONY: image-pushing
+image-pushing-presubmit:
+ifeq ($(JOB_TYPE),periodic)
+	$(MAKE) -j3 image-pushing-periodic
+else
+	$(MAKE) -j5 image-pushing-presubmit
+endif
+
+.PHONY: image-pushing-presubmit
+image-pushing-presubmit: image-push helm-chart-push kueueviz-image-push kueue-populator-image-push kueue-priority-booster-image-push
```

  _⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🔴 Critical_ | _⚡ Quick win_
  
  **Target name mismatch causes build failure.**
  
  Line 247 declares `.PHONY: image-pushing`, but line 248 defines `image-pushing-presubmit:` instead of `image-pushing:`. Since `cloudbuild.yaml` invokes `make image-pushing`, the build will fail with "No rule to make target 'image-pushing'".
  
  Additionally, as the static analysis flagged, `image-pushing-presubmit` is defined twice (lines 248 and 256), which is unintended.
  
  
  
  
  
  
  <details>
  <summary>🐛 Proposed fix</summary>
  
  ```diff
   .PHONY: image-pushing
  -image-pushing-presubmit:
  +image-pushing:
   ifeq ($(JOB_TYPE),periodic)
   	$(MAKE) -j3 image-pushing-periodic
   else
   	$(MAKE) -j5 image-pushing-presubmit
   endif
  ```
  </details>
